ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: Figure b in <image1> is a schematic diagram of prevailing wind direction and river flow. The river flow curve is relatively high at the beginning and end of the year, and clearly decreases to a low point around July, showing high flow in winter and low flow in summer. Reasoning: High river flow usually corresponds to more precipitation, and low river flow corresponds to less precipitation; therefore, precipitation in this place is concentrated in winter and summer is dry, conforming to the characteristics of a Mediterranean climate. A typical crop or fruit suitable for growing under a Mediterranean climate is olive.
